messages:
anya: tl;dr proposal: split adapter manifest into a tiny core + mode extensions to avoid hosted-specific leakage.

matt: sounds reasonable. main risk is migration friction for adapters and control-plane consumers.

anya: plan: support both shapes during transition, add `manifest-check` CLI, and provide conversion helpers in controlplane repo.

reza: we need a canonical capability list so planner doesn't parse arbitrary fields. infra own registry?

olivia: yes. registry + a lightweight adapter probe (GET /probe -> capabilities[]) so runtime truth can be read quickly.

infra-bot: ACTION: created INFRA-4301 "capability registry endpoint".

anya: secret handling: core only carries secret refs; extension declares secret class. do not embed secrets in hosted manifests.

matt: also keep adapter-facing API stable while we migrate. shadow-read the new shape first.

anya: i'll draft RFC with examples and a migration checklist. will post in #architecture-rfcs in 24h.

reza: testing: converter unit tests + planner capability-satisfaction tests + e2e fallback scenarios.

olivia: +1, include UI rendering checklist for console.
